text: This lesson builds the Executive front-end's foundation: a Power BI data model connected directly to the same validated warehouse every other deliverable in this capstone reads from.

Four relationships rebuild the exact star shape Lesson 3 designed in T-SQL, each one one-to-many from a dimension to the fact table. DimDate gets explicitly marked as the model's date table, which is what lets Power BI's time-intelligence functions treat it as a real calendar.

This model deliberately leaves out DimSalesReason and its bridge table. The Executive dashboard answers how much was sold and where, not why — and importing a bridge table it doesn't need would only add fan-out risk for no benefit.
Next lesson writes the real DAX measures this model needs, including a company-wide benchmark that ignores whatever territory filter is currently applied.
